verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions reports in general: reconciliation reports, the A/R aging report, AI-generated reports on request, and 11 financial reports exposed through the MCP server. Nothing documents building custom reports filtered or grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions. The custom roles, workflows and fields in docs-4 are a related but different feature, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
